page_title: HAV 3-1 STR | Le Havre v Strasbourg 04/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+5' 3 - 1 Goal! Andre Ayew (Le Havre) pounced on a loose ball inside the penalty area and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the bottom right corner. He makes it 3:1.
90+2' Substitution. Josue Casimir is replaced by Alois Confais (Le Havre).
90+2' Luka Elsner has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Samuel Grandsir (Le Havre) replacing Emmanuel Sabbi.
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
90' Here comes a substitution. Aboubacar Ali Abdallah (Strasbourg) is brought on as a substitute for Thomas Delaine.
90' Le Havre take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
88' The referee blows his whistle as Thomas Delaine (Strasbourg) was too aggressive in his challenge.
88' Arthur Desmas (Le Havre) is awarded a yellow card.

86' 2 - 1 Frederic Guilbert (Strasbourg) jumped highest to meet a perfectly executed corner kick by Dilane Bakwa. His header was precise and ended up in the back of the net, leaving the goalkeeper flapping in the wind. The score is 2:1.
86' Strasbourg get a corner.
85' 12:4 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
83' Lucas Perrin (Strasbourg) brings his opponent down. Jerome Brisard has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
80' A substitution has been made. Oussama Targhalline goes off and Daler Kuzyaev (Le Havre) comes on.
80' Luka Elsner has decided to substitute Yassine Kechta and he is replaced by Oualid El Hajjam (Le Havre).
78' Substitution. Junior Mwanga (Strasbourg) on for Andrey Santos.

76' Christopher Operi (Le Havre) produces an accurate shot from the free kick. His promising effort flies towards the bottom left corner, but is blocked by Alaa Bellaarouch, who makes a fine save to keep the ball from hitting the net.
75' Ibrahima Sissoko (Strasbourg) has received a yellow card for his foul.
72' Jerome Brisard couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Ibrahima Sissoko (Strasbourg) and blew his whistle.
71' Thomas Delaine (Strasbourg) shoots from the free kick, but his good effort flies just wide of the left post.
69' Oussama Targhalline (Le Havre) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Strasbourg have a free kick from a promising distance.
68' The current number of corner kicks is 2:1.
65' 2 - 0 Goal! Josue Casimir picks out Yassine Kechta (Le Havre) in the box with a decent cross, and he scores in the left side of the goal with a header from close range. 2:0.
62' Patrick Vieira prepares a substitution. Marvin Senaya is replaced by Moise Sahi Dion (Strasbourg).
62' Today's match ends for Jeremy Sebas who will be replaced by Kevin Gameiro (Strasbourg).
59' Andrey Santos (Strasbourg) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Jerome Brisard blows his whistle for a foul.

59' Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) attempts to convert a lofted cross as he jumps high and heads the ball towards the roof of the net. Arthur Desmas shows his brilliant reflexes and pulls off a glorious save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
56' Jerome Brisard blows his whistle. Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) commits a foul after dangerous play.
56' Abdoulaye Toure (Le Havre) was close to scoring after he unleashed a powerful shot which went a whisker wide of the right post.
54' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
54' Yassine Kechta (Le Havre) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Jerome Brisard didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
53' Jerome Brisard blows his whistle and signals a foul after Yassine Kechta (Le Havre) brought his opponent down.
51' Marvin Senaya (Strasbourg) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
50' Andre Ayew (Le Havre) makes a strong challenge and Jerome Brisard blows for a foul.
48' Josue Casimir (Le Havre) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
47' Thomas Delaine (Strasbourg) brings an opponent down and Jerome Brisard interrupts the game.
46' The game is interrupted. Lucas Perrin (Strasbourg) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
46' Jerome Brisard blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+6' The match has reached half-time.
45+3' Close! Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) unleashes a rocket of a shot from the edge of the box and his shot flies just a few inches over the crossbar.
45' 5 additional min. will be played.
43' The game is interrupted. One of the players from Strasbourg is cautioned for aggressive play.
42' Jeremy Sebas (Strasbourg) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
41' The foul by Yoann Salmier (Le Havre) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Jerome Brisard.
41' A player from Le Havre commits a rough challenge. Jerome Brisard blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
37' Gautier Lloris (Le Havre) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
34' The number of shots on goal at present is 1:1.
34' Strasbourg are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
29' Strasbourg take a short corner kick.

24' 1 - 0 Josue Casimir sends a superb cross into the box. Yassine Kechta (Le Havre) latches on to it and from close range plants a header into the roof of the net, leaving Alaa Bellaarouch beaten. He displayed his eye for goal there - excellent finish. The score is 1:0.
24' Thomas Delaine (Strasbourg) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Jerome Brisard blows for a foul.
23' Abdoulaye Toure (Le Havre) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
21' Gautier Lloris (Le Havre) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Jerome Brisard blows for a foul.
20' Le Havre have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
18' Jerome Brisard interrupts the game. One of the players from Strasbourg won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
12' Gautier Lloris (Le Havre) with a powerful header hits the post.
11' Le Havre can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
10' Andrey Santos (Strasbourg) wastes a big chance! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box and it goes narrowly over the crossbar.
9' Ibrahima Sissoko (Strasbourg) commits a rough challenge and Jerome Brisard blows his whistle for an infringement.
8' Andre Ayew (Le Havre) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
5' Marvin Senaya (Strasbourg) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
2' The ball spins up and hits the hand of Marvin Senaya (Strasbourg) after he fails to control it and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
1' Ibrahima Sissoko (Strasbourg) knocks his opponent down with an over-the-top tackle.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Strasbourg will have the kick-off.
Jerome Brisard will supervise the game today.
